description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_1d_dirichlet_o4.esm (model Heat, test mms_dirichlet_o4_decay) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the parameterized inhomogeneous-Dirichlet fourth-order rule central_D2_4_dirichlet_bc (5-point interior stencil plus one-sided fourth-order boundary-row closures) with constant nonzero wall values gL=0.5, gR=1.5 matched to the manufactured linear profile. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to <2e-6 relative on every resolution of the stiff heat sweep.

Deterministic LSODA/RK45-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: mms_dirichlet_o4_decay[2] rel 1.00e-02 / abs 2.65e-12 (ref 2.650315e-10). MEASURED from CI run 33272496703 (2026-08-29); the values are bit-stable across runs and the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
